0|bf3f00378524adae16628cbadbd11ba7211863bb|torvalds~linux|/home/usuario01/Titan-Files-Research/src/_00/output/C/torvalds~linux|False|"libbpf: Fix the name of a reused map
BPF map name is limited to BPF_OBJ_NAME_LEN.
A map name is defined as being longer than BPF_OBJ_NAME_LEN
it will be truncated to BPF_OBJ_NAME_LEN when a userspace program
calls libbpf to create the map. A pinned map also generates a path
in the /sys. If the previous program wanted to reuse the map，
it can not get bpf_map by name
column2: because the name of the map is only

column1: partially the same as the name which get from pinned path.
The syscall information below show that map name ""process_pinned_map""
is truncated to ""process_pinned_"".
bpf(BPF_OBJ_GET
bpf_fd=0
bpf(BPF_MAP_CREATE
value_size=4
map_name=""process_pinned_""
btf_value_type_id=10
This patch check that if the name of pinned map are the same as the
actual name for the first (BPF_OBJ_NAME_LEN - 1)
bpf map still uses the name which is included in bpf object.
Fixes: 26736eb9a483 (""tools: libbpf: allow map reuse"")
